build_feature_matrix.note: ideal 1 per fit (PRF-18): the screen matrix is rebuilt by the tiny rerank, the honest gate and the y-scale gate

near_collinear_keep_mask.note: ideal 1 correlation build per target (PRF-01): one per base context plus the unary context

lgb_Dataset.note: ideal: one per distinct (matrix, fold or fit-row set) (PRF-07); the tiny CV, the raw-y CV, the honest gate and the y-scale gate share binned datasets per (matrix, rows, thread); the rest are distinct row sets per spec (masked folds, per-base matrices) and the WAIC folds of different bases

yscale_predicts_per_wrapper_split.note: ideal 2 (PRF-13/14): the per-model hook (before the phase) plus one phase predict; the wrap-pass watchdog's y-scale predict and the refit pre-screen's predict (through its shim) read the same split in two different frame objects, which the identity-keyed phase memo cannot join

pp_transforms_per_pipeline_frame.note: ideal 1 per (pipeline, frame) (PRF-16): the training transform, the per-model hook (before the phase memo) and one memoised phase transform
